title: Save and reuse object formatting
summary: Save a selected object's formatting as a local template, then apply it to matching objects with one click.

Added: Working Quick Styles for Text, Line, Step, rectangles, ellipses, polygons and callouts, plus intensity presets for Blur and Pixelate.
Save as template captures one selected object's formatting. Use an automatic name or enter your own; templates persist locally across restarts.
Click any preset or saved template to update a compatible selection immediately. The active tile has a visible border, and one Undo reverses the batch.
Templates retain each object's position, size, paths, callout pointer and individual text. Existing arrow styles remain available.
Verified: Native repeated callout preset changes, custom save and batch application, active borders and one-step Undo passed.
Native Text, Line, Rectangle, Step, Ellipse, Polygon, Blur and Pixelate presets produce eight independently checked editable objects and 256000 exact clipboard pixels.
Local checks cover atomic batch application, no-op history, content/geometry preservation, persistence, malformed data and locked storage.

limitations: The new templates apply to existing objects of exactly one type. They do not yet set defaults for newly drawn objects. Arrow drawing defaults retain their existing behavior.
Simplify and advanced tool options remain unfinished. Text entry is still dialog-based; inline centered text in shapes, text boxes and callouts is the next priority.
Template tiles show a type/color glyph rather than a complete preview of every formatting property.
Crisp vector zoom, smooth callout joins, continuous editable autosave and draggable toolbar ordering remain tracked. Physical middle-button drag verification is pending.
